metadata.value: This repo contains the supported code and configuration files to reproduce semantic segmentation results of [Swin Transformer](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2103.14030.pdf). It is based on [mmsegmentaion](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsegmentation/tree/v0.11.0). In addition, we provide pre-trained models for the semantic segmentation of satellite images into basic classes (vegetation, buildings, roads).
